description: Concentric radial bars, one per device, each running around a gray background track.
overview: Uses `RadialBarChart` with `innerRadius="25%"`, `outerRadius="100%"` and `barSize={12}`, and one `RadialBar` (`dataKey="users"`, `cornerRadius={10}`) with `background={{ fill: "var(--control)" }}`. `chartData` holds four `{ device, users, fill }` records, where each `fill` is `var(--color-<device>)`, and `chartConfig` defines `users` (label only) plus `phone`, `laptop`, `tablet` and `watch` colored `var(--blue)`, `var(--teal)`, `var(--indigo)` and `var(--orange)`. The tooltip uses `hideLabel` and `nameKey="device"`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your categories, giving each a `fill` of `var(--color-<key>)`, and add a matching `chartConfig` entry with `label` and `color`. Update the tooltip's `nameKey` if you rename the `device` field. Without a `PolarAngleAxis`, bar lengths are scaled relative to the largest value; add one with a numeric `domain` if you need a fixed scale.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on `RadialBarChart`, so the chart is focusable from the keyboard.
